violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Dishwashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 0ppm chlorine. The dish-ware is not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC discontinued use the dish machine and set up 3 compartment sink for properly sanitizing dish-ware. PIC properly sanitized the dish-ware.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions (for 3-compartment sink).
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a quaternary ammonia test kit during inspection.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: OBSERVATION:When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: @ trays, plastic tubs other utensils in the low temperature Dish machine which registered chlorine at 0 PPM when measures using Chlorine test strip.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTED DURING INSPECTION: Dish machine will be discontinued until repaired. All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning.
